description: Scan top DeFi yield opportunities across protocols: Aave, Compound, Morpho, Lido, Pendle, and more. Filter by chain, asset, and minimum TVL. Returns provider reported APY and TVL without a safety rating. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402 micropayment on Base).

asset.description: Filter by asset symbol (e.g. "ETH", "USDC", "stETH"). Omit for all assets.

chain.description: Blockchain to filter by (e.g. "ethereum", "base", "arbitrum", "polygon"). Omit for all chains.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–50). Defaults to 20.

min_tvl.description: Minimum TVL in USD (e.g. 1000000 for $1M). Omit for no minimum.

name: scan_yields
